query: Add a /campaigns page that lists campaigns from Supabase and needs them visible on first paint, plus a client-side 'create campaign' form with an optimistic update that prepends the new row to the list.
baseline_failure: Agent makes the whole page 'use client' and fetches the list with TanStack Query (loses RSC first paint), OR keeps it RSC and calls router.refresh() after the mutation (full re-render, no optimism). Either way one owner is dropped.
expected_behavior: RSC owns the read through a server-only DAL/read entrypoint and renders first paint
The read seeds the client island as initialData with an explicit freshness decision (initialDataUpdatedAt from the server timestamp, or 0 to refetch immediately)
The optimistic create invalidates/updates whichever owner controls the read
Names that the seeding is the rare hybrid case, not the default
anti_expectation: Does NOT apply the hybrid seed to a pure search/filter list (that is client lifecycle only)
Does NOT apply it to a static page with no writes (that is RSC props only)
Does NOT hand-pass initialData to multiple islands instead of a hydration strategy

baseline_observed.method: fresh subagent, no skill loaded; 2-cell bracket: sonnet+neutral (best case) and haiku+adversarial ('keep it simple and modern')
baseline_observed.verdict: Only haiku+adversarial ('keep it simple and modern') goes RED: it put the server list into useState with a broken optimistic sync (revalidatePath only). haiku+neutral produced the correct RSC+initialData+optimistic-rollback hybrid (one minor double-mutation smell), same as sonnet. So the failure is weak-model + lazy framing, not weak-model alone. Reference value is narrow: a guardrail against lazy prompting, near-zero for strong models or neutral prompts. n=1 per cell.
